purpose: Maps the v38 pension-housing demand/friction signal into the same canonical Stödassistenten regression system.

mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Route pension-plus-housing/economy language into the existing person product with only actor/focus/language state. Ask the current route-changing age/full-public-pension/residence facts before detailed financial information, use Pensionsmyndigheten's current preliminary calculator for housing/income/assets/household details, prefer current authority pages over stale official PDFs, and do not route sickness/activity-compensation housing-support questions into the pensioner authority path merely because the benefit name is similar.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Do not put raw stories, pension values, rent, assets, household finances, partner identity or other financial details in URLs, feedback or public regression data. Feedback may contain only the existing structured anonymous product fields.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Do not promote the existing Pensionsmyndigheten support record to VERIFIED. Eligibility, amount, current age boundary, agency responsibility and application behavior remain primary-source governed and must fail closed when context is missing or conflicting.
